s.note: the whole bank dragged through the streets of Saint Martin
s.how: Mix 150g grated parmesan with chopped thyme. Spoon small rounds onto a lined tray and flatten into coins. Bake at 190C for 6 minutes until golden. Cool and pile them high like a stolen bank vault with fig jam.

Whisk 100g flour and 50g cornflour with ice-cold soda water to a thin lumpy batter. Dip 500g green prawns and fry at 180C until puffed and crisp. Stir lime juice into sweet chilli sauce and serve for dipping.

m.how: Soften crushed garlic and chopped chilli in oil, add 2 diced tomatoes and 400ml coconut milk and simmer 5 minutes. Add 4 snapper fillets and simmer 10 minutes. Squeeze in lime and serve over jasmine rice.

w.how: Blind bake a sweet shortcrust case until crisp. Heat 300ml cream and pour over 300g chopped dark chocolate, stirring until glossy. Pour into the case and chill overnight. Finish with sea salt flakes before slicing.

d.note: the bottle of rum Jack trades his compass for
d.how: Fill short glasses with ice. Pour 45ml dark rum over the ice for the pirates and squeeze in a wedge of lime. For the landlubbers, pour ginger beer over ice with lime instead.
